Prices are displayed in INR and represent the monthly cost per GB of RAM. Monthly totals are calculated as selected RAM (in GB) multiplied by the plan's per-GB rate. For example, 4 GB is ₹40/month on the Cheap plan, ₹80/month on the Budget plan, and ₹120/month on the Performance plan.

Online selections are limited to 32 GB. Larger requirements are handled through a Discord support ticket once the official invite is published.

All orders are processed through the HDXCLOUD client billing panel. SSD storage is included with every Minecraft plan.

HDXCLOUD

HDXCLOUD is an affordable Minecraft and cloud hosting brand offering transparent RAM-based plans, SSD storage, and a separate VPS / VM portal. Managed through external billing and virtualization control panels.
